skill.name: Fox-Fire
skill.description: Ahri gains a brief burst of Move Speed and releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies.

skill.name: Radiant Volley
skill.description: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.

skill.name: Solar Snare
skill.description: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.

skill.name: Sky Splitter
skill.description: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.
